    Our fire

    A brick oven that never really goes out

    Our oven is lit before sunrise and fed with seasoned post oak all day. By dinner the bricks hold a steady heat that sears the outside of a steak in minutes and leaves the inside rosy.

    480°COven floor temperature at service
    34Days every ribeye is dry aged in house
    18Months our oak is seasoned before it burns

    How a plate reaches you

    1. 1
      Rested, then seasonedSteaks come to room temperature and get salt, nothing else, an hour before the fire.
    2. 2
      Seared over open flameDirect heat for the crust, then moved to the cooler side to finish gently.
    3. 3
      Plated within a minuteSauces, herbs and sides are ready first so nothing waits on the pass.

      Questions

      Before you come

      Yes. We keep the bar and about a third of the room open for walk ins every night. Weekends fill early, so a reservation is the safest way to get a table.

      Most of the menu is gluten free, and we flag vegetarian dishes on every card. Tell us about allergies when you book or order and the kitchen will plan around them.

      We deliver within 5 miles of Foundry Row. Delivery is $4.99, and free on orders over $60. Steaks travel in vented boxes so the crust stays crisp.

      Most orders are ready in about 25 minutes. Large orders and anything with a dry aged steak can take a little longer, and we will tell you when you check out.

      Reply to your confirmation email or call us up to 2 hours before your time and we will move or cancel it at no charge.

      No. Ember and Oak is a portfolio concept. The menu, prices, reviews and address are sample content, and no payment is taken or booking made.
